description: Frozen clean holdout: ordinary fashion captions and alt text written natively in the language after the allow list froze, independently of the clean half, and never used to tune the screener, the lists or the allow list. The release gate's clean-copy figure is computed here. Entries labelled expected review carry one of the policy's deliberate review terms.

entries.text: rain again, swapped the suede loafers for rubber boots

Wet socks again.
Coat weather. Finally.

Cleaning salt stains off leather boots with a bit of vinegar and water. Works every time.

Cedar blocks in the sweater bins this year. Fingers crossed nothing gets nibbled.
Mid-season swap: kept a few summer dresses out because they work with tights and a cardigan.

Washing all the winter scarves before storing them. They deserve a fresh start too.
Seasonal swap but make it gradual. A few warm pieces at a time until the weather really commits.

Wardrobe swap tonight: all the linen goes to the top shelf, all the corduroy comes down.
Swapped my summer canvas tote for the leather one that can handle rain. Small seasonal ritual.

Moving the heavy knits to the vacuum bags. They shrink to almost nothing, it's like magic.
Spring is here, so the wool socks get washed, folded and put in the top drawer until November.
Bringing back the long-sleeve tees. Summer is clearly over.

Hung the light rain jacket next to the door again. The heavy one is going into storage.
Got all my sweaters out and realized I own six gray ones. Wearing a different one each day this week.
Packing away the winter coats, but the scarf stays. Spring evenings are still cool here.

Heading out for a walk in the first snow. Knit hat, mittens, the warmest coat I own.
